heroHeadline: Lab Worker Death Triggers WHO Biosafety Inquiry
heroSubtitle: 28-year-old researcher at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute died Oct 2 of pneumonia of unknown cause; Russia says no plague, lifts Irkutsk precautions Oct 9, WHO still seeks the pathogen
footerNote: This tracker monitors the October 2026 biosafety incident at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute and international health response.
